label: WebGL Cinematic Backdrop
description: Real-3D abstract world for DARK scenes: translucent curved ribbons drifting in fog, lit by brand-colored lights, with film grain and vignette (the launch-film backdrop look). Always z_index 0 with content components above it. Deterministic drift -- seeks exactly under render capture. Dark scene templates receive one automatically; codegen scenes can add it explicitly.

primary.label: Key light / ribbon hue (defaults to brand primary)

secondary.label: Rim light hue (defaults to brand secondary)

seed.label: Layout seed (vary per scene for different arrangements)
